definitions.explanation: a gift given to celebrate a child entering school

examples.japanese: {入学|にゅうがく}{祝|いわ}いに{鞄|かばん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a bag as a school entrance gift.

examples.japanese: {孫|まご}の{入学|にゅうがく}{祝|いわ}いに{何|なに}を{贈|おく}ろうか{迷|まよ}っている。
examples.english: I'm wondering what to give my grandchild for their school entrance gift.

examples.japanese: {祖父母|そふぼ}から{入学|にゅうがく}{祝|いわ}いとして{机|つくえ}を{贈|おく}ってもらった。
examples.english: My grandparents gave me a desk as a school entrance celebration gift.

notes:
JAPANESE EDUCATIONAL MILESTONES:
{入学|にゅうがく}{祝|いわ}い is given when a child enters {小学校|しょうがっこう} (elementary school), {中学校|ちゅうがっこう} (middle school), {高校|こうこう} (high school), or {大学|だいがく} (university).

COMMON GIFTS BY LEVEL:
- {小学校|しょうがっこう}{入学|にゅうがく}: ランドセル (school backpack), {学習机|がくしゅうつくえ} (study desk), {文房具|ぶんぼうぐ} (stationery)
- {中学|ちゅうがく}・{高校|こうこう}{入学|にゅうがく}: {腕時計|うでどけい} (wristwatch), {財布|さいふ} (wallet), {現金|げんきん} (cash)
- {大学|だいがく}{入学|にゅうがく}: パソコン (computer), {現金|げんきん} (cash)

AMOUNT:
Cash gifts range from 10,000 to 50,000 yen depending on the relationship and school level.
